readout_decomposition.d_null: M_C(real conflict new) - M_C(valid length-matched neutral)
readout_decomposition.query_key_vectors: q_i = W_Q h_decide_i + b_Q; d_i = (W_K h_true_i+b_K) - (W_K h_false_i+b_K)
readout_decomposition.identity: Delta_M = (Delta_q . d_old + q_old . Delta_d + Delta_q . Delta_d)/(sqrt(256)*T)
readout_decomposition.interpretation: Exact readout algebra, not by itself upstream causal mediation
readout_decomposition.reconstruction: Before any patch, raw logits from model.forward_rows_batch and cached q,k must agree per candidate to chosen FP32 tolerance; verify marker positions/branch hashes; if not, STOP
